CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_downloads (
  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  user_id INT NOT NULL,
  month VARCHAR(7) NOT NULL,
  download_count INT DEFAULT 0,
  download_limit INT DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX idx_user_month (user_id, month)
);

-- Inserir registro demo para usuário 1 (mês atual)
INSERT INTO user_downloads (user_id, month, download_count, download_limit)
VALUES (1, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m'), 2, 5)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE download_count = 2, download_limit = 5;
